content:
The attempt to set the bucket policy for "ops-audit-2023" to grant the "collector" principal the "s3:PutObject" permission has repeatedly failed due to a "l2_policy:deny" error. This suggests that the bucket policy or an external policy is preventing the action.

Since the policy is not within the declared scope and we are prohibited from altering it, we must escalate the ticket due to the inability to meet the required conditions.
